title: HelpDesk Version 3.0.0 Update
summary: Major release: streamlined ticket replies, staff-only ticket actions, restored close modal, direct Watching status, updated Leadership applications, and Founder DM deployment notifications.
added: Added staff-only /claim to claim an unclaimed ticket without accidentally unclaiming it.
Added staff-only /close with the same close-reason popup as the Close Ticket button.
Added deployment update DMs to Grey R. (Discord ID 1263248306264608871), with duplicate safeguards.
changed: Successful /reply commands now silently dismiss the slash-command acknowledgement; failures still report an error.
Ticket claim/close buttons, /ticket control, /reply, /ping, /message edit, /message config, and /format now require the Delta Support role.
Removed Close Ticket from /ticket control but preserved Founder-only administrative close.
Set the Watching activity directly to 'staff forget to claim tickets'.
Updated Leadership Application role availability without changing the CV, statement, or application questions.
Fixed customer DM relay failing on an undefined follow-up variable and restored the regular-message partnership advertisement in ticket mirrors.
removed: Removed success-confirmation messages after normal /reply delivery.

history.summary: Ticket message controls, customer pings, Founder support controls, and ticket-only logs.
Incremental ticket management and support workflow updates.
Transcript delivery fixes and updated DM panel notice.
Department-specific support instructions and corrected Grey R. mentions.
